project_context: Hybrid Fullstack SaaS Chat + Analytics Dashboard
theme: Strict Dark Mode (The 'Command Center' Aesthetic). Designed for data engineers and analysts interacting with Splunk and BigQuery.

typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk (Weights: 700-900). Use for auth screen, empty states, and major section titles. Tracking must be tight.
typography.body: Satoshi (Weights: 400-500). Clean, geometric, used for standard UI text, conversational text, and form inputs.
typography.data_and_code: JetBrains Mono. CRITICAL: Use this for ALL data tables, chart axes, data-source chips (Splunk/BigQuery), timestamps, and markdown code blocks. Creates a technical, terminal-like trust.

colors.rules: NEVER use purple-on-white gradients. Gradients are banned except for subtle 1px border glows or specific chart fill gradients (fade to transparent). Use solid, stark colors to convey 'truth' and data accuracy.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' - expose the UI skeleton. Containers should have 1px solid borders (`border-white/10`). NO soft shadows on dark mode. Use 1px inner highlights (`shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]`) to define depth.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Keep it sharp. Max `rounded-sm` (4px). Avoid pills unless it's a specific toggle. Data tools look more precise with sharp edges.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky elements (like the chat composer or header). Use `backdrop-blur-xl` with `bg-[#050505]/80` and a `border-t border-white/10`. CRITICAL: Never use fully transparent backgrounds where content scrolls beneath.

layouts.auth_screen: Split screen layout. Left: Full-height abstract data visualization image with a `bg-black/40` overlay. Right: Minimalist login form centered, using Shadcn inputs but fully squared.

main_chat.sidebar: Fixed width (e.g., 280px), extremely dense `JetBrains Mono` list of past chats. Hairline right border separating from main.
main_chat.transcript: Edge-to-edge block layout, not iMessage-style bubbles. Assistant messages have a subtle `bg-white/[0.02]` background and a 2px left border (`border-l-splunk_accent` or `border-l-bigquery_accent` depending on data source).
main_chat.composer: Bottom-docked, full width of transcript container. Sharp rectangle. Data-source chips (Splunk/BigQuery) sit just above or inside the composer.

layouts.connections_page: High-density Grid Mode. `gap-6`, `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`. Connection cards should look like physical hardware slots—1px borders, mono status indicators (Connected/Disconnected) with a pulsing 6px colored dot.

components_and_libraries.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react). Use duotone for active states, regular for idle.
components_and_libraries.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Strip all default generic styling. Axes must be JetBrains Mono. Use `splunk_accent` and `bigquery_accent` for bars/lines. Enable grid lines but make them incredibly faint (`stroke-white/5`).
components_and_libraries.tables: Shadcn Table. Extremely dense. `p-2` cells. JetBrains Mono entirely. Hover states should highlight the entire row `bg-white/5`.
components_and_libraries.toasts: Sonner. Placed bottom-right, sharp edges, dark theme forced.
components_and_libraries.markdown: react-markdown. Style `pre` blocks as stark dark rectangles with 1px border. Render tables cleanly with hairline borders.
components_and_libraries.buttons: Sharp rectangles (`rounded-sm`). Solid white `bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200` for primary actions. `border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10` for secondary. Avoid colored buttons except for destructive actions.

motion.micro_interactions: Hovering buttons/cards should not lift up; instead, increase border opacity (`border-white/40`) or text brightness. It feels more mechanical.
motion.chat_streaming: Apply a subtle staggered opacity fade-in to markdown elements as they appear, imitating a typing effect without layout shift.
motion.page_transitions: Framer Motion. Fade in (`opacity: 0 to 1`) and slight scale down (`scale: 1.02 to 1`) for a sharp 'snapping' into focus effect.

accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds must meet APCA or WCAG AA 4.5:1. Use `#A3A3A3` for secondary text against `#050505`.
accessibility.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g., `data-testid='login-form-submit-button'`, `data-testid='chat-send-btn'`, `data-testid='data-source-chip-splunk'`).

auth_background.description: Abstract data geometry dark background. Use for the left side of the split Auth screen.

user_avatar.description: Professional avatar. Use in the user profile menu/logout area in the sidebar.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use generic blue themes. Stick strictly to the #050505 void black base and stark white primary text.
Use JetBrains Mono aggressively for data elements. If data looks like a blog post, you have failed. It must look like a command center.
Never use soft bubbles for chat messages. Use full-width separated blocks with distinct background hues for distinction.
The connections page MUST look robust and technical, not playful. Solid borders, clear status indicators.
Ensure the PDF download button stands out but matches the brutalist aesthetic (e.g., sharp outline button).
Use Lucide icons if Phosphor is unavailable, but keep stroke widths thin (1.5px max) for a sharp look.
